office: the commune administration (Ministry of the Interior)

routes.label: in person at the town hall or commune office: the same day or the next

note: Isôko, the state's portal of administrative procedures (isoko.gov.bi, served over plain http; read 2026-11-03): the CNI is compulsory and issued to every Burundian from 16; it costs 500 Burundian francs at the town hall or commune office, and is ready the same day or the next, held as within a day. Until then the entry stood on the IRB of Canada's response (2020) quoting the portal, which gave no time, so the time was null. The card's term isn't stated.
